"Livin' It Up" is a song by American rapper Ja Rule featuring singer Case.
It was officially serviced to US urban radio on September 10, 2001, as the lead single from Ja Rule's third studio album, Pain Is Love (2001), following several weeks of early airplay.
The song, produced by Lil' Rob and Irv Gotti, samples Stevie Wonder's 1982 song "Do I Do".
Exodus is a 2005 greatest hits album by rapper Ja Rule.
He had released an album every year since 1999, but in 2005, with no new album planned, The Inc.
released this greatest hits album featuring songs such as "Mesmerize" and "Wonderful".
Jeffrey Bruce Atkins (born February 29, 1976), better known by his stage name Ja Rule (), is an American rapper, singer, and actor.
Born and raised in Queens, New York City, Ja Rule became known for blending gangsta rap with pop and R&B sensibilities.
